what: The null arm: six paper titles written by this practice for this session, in the region of its own work, each verified not to name any existing paper BEFORE any delegate was dispatched.
why: A refusal announces itself; a fabrication does not. The real arms measure whether a delegated read quotes the paper it was given. This arm measures the other half: what a delegated read does when there is nothing to read.

verification.web: exact-phrase search of the title (delegated web search, 2026-09-14). Recorded value is the number of results returned.
verification.arxiv_title: https://arxiv.org/search/?searchtype=title&query=<title>, counted as occurrences of the result-list title class. Recorded value is the number of hits.
verification.arxiv_title_control: the same checker run on an existing title from this session's own sample, 'The Curse of Recursion: Training on Generated Data Makes Models Forget', returned 1 hit - so a zero is a zero and not a broken parse.
verification.arxiv_api_note: the arXiv export API answered 429 Rate exceeded to every request from this session's egress while arxiv.org itself answered 200, so the API-side check could not be run and the two checks above stand in its place. Filed against open question 46: how much of what we call unreachable is our own request.

no_authors: No author names are invented and none are given to the delegates. Inventing a person and attaching a paper to them is a claim about a named third party, and this practice does not make one.
years: Three null titles are dated like the OLD stratum and three like the NEW stratum, so the arm is not identifiable by its dates.
